scope: Read-only first-loop preparation; no modeling, rendering, production launch or future-candidate acceptance.
context_limit: Existing reviewer reused for preparation. This does not replace fresh independent Equilibrium review of future frozen candidates.
record_type: Architect structured summary of completed reviewer report, cross-checked against directly viewed source and checkpoint09 pixels.
owner_progress_assessment: Checkpoint09 is useful more-than-incremental progress, with final source likeness still unmet.
observed_gains: Compact rounded shoulder and swept crown
Connected throat/breast flow and warmer forehead metal
Weightier feet and denser exposed flank machinery

priorities.gap: Smooth forehead and uninterrupted hanging bill dominate; thin cheek framing surrounds a large void.
priorities.correction: Resolve brow/optic seat, bill-root outline and recessed cheek cluster together; preserve useful optic direction and use July only for head identity.

priorities.gap: Long smooth lower-breast panels create a stretched decorative rhythm.
priorities.correction: Rework plate scale and direction through throat, breast and flank as a connected region, keeping compact shoulder, exposed transmission and inherited stance anchors.

priorities.gap: Broad clean surfaces lack source-specific local construction depth.
priorities.correction: Apply a few source-matched pivots, seams, sockets and edge treatments to corrected forms after the whole-character gate; do not substitute global scratch noise.

first_loop_gate.comparison: Pinned locked full-bird source, immutable09 and integrated candidate triptych at equal displayed bird height, crown and feet included.
first_loop_gate.controlled_views: Baseline and candidate use identical cameras, neutral and workshop lighting, relevant head/body crops and rear continuity.
first_loop_gate.judgment: Head identity, throat/breast integration, compact shoulder and planted weight must improve coherently at whole-character scale.
first_loop_gate.limitation: Estimated source camera and unobserved depth remain uncertain; equal displayed size is not calibrated source metrology.

defer: Foot segmentation is a later refinement; do not enlarge or reposition feet to compensate for current head/breast gaps.
